function.arguments: {"finding": "The data contains 261 rows with assay_batch == 'B', and the documentation states that batch-B analyser reports in µg/L, not ng/mL. This affects the estimand because the baseline biomarker must be in ng/mL.", "implication": "We must convert `biomarker_baseline` values from batch B to ng/mL by dividing by 10 before computing the mean. function.name: note_finding
